secondary: other: foods spilled from the bowl, tilted > 45 deg in the rim grasp, while it was raised at the fridge opening
what_happened: Layout 9 (side-by-side fridge, narrow open right compartment), deep brown bowl_8, lime, drumstick 011. Stage 0: lime grasped 88 and dropped in the bowl 169 (stage 0 at 171). Stage 1: drumstick grasped 307, released in the bowl 404 (stage 1 at 407, normal). Stage 2: rim grasp at 444-456 (width ~0.027), lifting the bowl 0.63 m in total over the episode; from 562 the lime was pinched against the rim inside the fingers too. The bowl tilted past 45 deg at 621 and stayed tilted for the rest of the episode. At the fridge (~700) the arm raised the tilted bowl high at the right edge of the opening; the fingers loosened slightly (0.026 -> 0.045, 744-864). The drumstick slid out at ~780-792 and fell to the floor (drop 1.32 m), the lime at ~836-852 (drop 1.02 m). Stages 0 and 1 broke for good at ~790 and 852. From ~870 to 1700 the empty bowl sat tilted at the very top of the compartment, above the top shelf (end z 1.585, tilt 79), while the gripper closed on nothing (872, 1456, 1576, 1656), reopened and pushed at it. It was never set on a shelf.
causal_chain: rim grasp let the bowl tilt > 45 deg during the carry (621) -> at the fridge the arm lifted the tilted bowl high and the grip loosened -> drumstick (~785) and lime (~845) slid out and fell to the floor (stages 0/1 undone) -> empty bowl then wedged at the top of the compartment until the timeout
self_recovery: none for the spilled foods. 870-1700: several re-grasps and pushes on the bowl at the top of the fridge, none of which put it on a shelf.
official_criterion_notes: The bowl's 'hold' 452-1144 runs on while the gripper is open (0.079 from 944) because the bowl rests against the fingers high in the fridge; it is not a real grasp after ~870.
